people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.
translations.bsb: And next to them, the Tekoites repaired another section, from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel.
translations.kjv: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
translations.asv: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, over against the great tower that standeth out, and unto the wall of Ophel.
